code_hints: After navigation to PLP, immediately attempt to click any of the consent/geo buttons in click_once_selectors before waiting for product tiles.
Use incremental scrolling (plp_scroll) and re-query for product links after each step; consider the PLP loaded once >= 12 unique PDP links match valid_pdp_regex.
When extracting PDP data, if CSS selectors fail, parse the first script[type='application/ld+json'] and read name and offers.price as a fallback.
Ensure all PDP links you enqueue preserve the locale prefix from the seed (e.g., /en-de/); if a discovered link is locale-less, prefix it with the current locale.
Wait for network idle after dismissing the consent modal, as PLP content is hydrated client-side.
rationale: The PLP likely failed to materialize due to a cookie/geo-consent modal blocking hydration and due to lazy rendering of the product grid. Adding robust consent dismissors, waiting for common product-card anchors, and enabling incremental scrolling should reveal product tiles. PDP selectors are broadened and augmented with microdata-based fallbacks to reliably capture price/title. URL rules ensure we stay on moncler.com, preserve the initial locale (/en-de), avoid corporate monclergroup.com, and only treat .html endpoints as valid PDPs.
